title: File:Falcon 9 rollout with TurkmenAlem52E-MonacoSAT to SLC-40 (17108097439).jpg
desc: A SpaceX Falcon 9 v1.1 rocket is rolled out to Cape Canaveral Space Launch Complex 40 on April 26, 2015, in advance of the April 27 launch attempt for the TurkmenÄlem52E/MonacoSAT telecommunications satellite.
